# AC opposition: English forensic working edition — 21 September 2026

**Public-safe verification receipt only. The populated Word document, standalone reader, original PDF and detailed annotation ledger are not uploaded to this public repository.**

This additive record preserves the existence, exact digests, annotation method and bounded technical verification of the two privately supplied derivatives. It does not replace the existing source register or allocate a new evidence, event, actor or proceeding identity.

## Verified package

The [machine-readable receipt](AC_OPPOSITION_EN_REVIEW_20260921.json) records two derivative SHA-256 digests, the embedded original PDF's digest, its 22 pages, and 84 sequential annotations (`A001`–`A084`). All 84 Word comments have matching range-start, range-end and reference anchors. The reader has no missing internal anchor targets or duplicate DOM IDs. The embedded PDF bytes match the reader's declared source hash.

Those checks establish bounded structural consistency, not source authenticity, certified translation, evidential truth, legal correctness, deliberate falsehood or liability. The translation remains **WORKING / NOT CERTIFIED**. This repository update did not repeat the full underlying merits review.

## Review semantics retained

| Colour | Review layer | Count |
|---|---|---:|
| Yellow | Not accepted without verification | 20 |
| Orange | Challenged inference / missing context | 28 |
| Orange | Contested characterisation / legal position | 6 |
| Red | Identified textual inconsistency, not knowing falsity | 2 |
| Purple | Evidential connection, not transferred responsibility | 11 |
| Blue | Express position / acknowledgment / notice | 8 |
| Green | Corroboration / material qualification | 9 |

The existing private reader stores purple entries under the machine category `ADOPTION`, but its displayed label is `LINK`. Preserve that mapping without treating the category name as proof that any person adopted a proposition. Colours classify review treatment; they are not confidence scores or findings of guilt. Rejection, inference, documentary connection, contrary evidence and unresolved proof remain separate.

## Continuity and boundaries

Follow the existing [forensic-reader recovery control](../../../ops/forensic-reader/RECOVERY_20260921.md), [reader documentation](../../../tools/forensic-reader/README.md) and [schema](../../../tools/forensic-reader/SCHEMA.md). The new receipt does not supersede earlier private working editions. The original and the two supplied derivatives remain byte-unchanged.

Do not mistake a standalone HTML reader for a tested import into the deployed `pd.forensic.v1` tool. Import/schema compatibility has not been tested here. Recover the private artifacts through their authorised source system and match their digests before any further work; do not reconstruct them from public Git metadata. Exact-byte private-vault receipts for these new derivatives were not verified in this update, so no deletion-safe or disaster-recovery-safe claim is made.

No private source bytes, populated derivative bytes, detailed annotations, private email references or legal strategy are included. Public release would require a separate reviewed/redacted derivative and an explicit source/privacy decision. No website route, site content, runtime, navigation, asset, deployment configuration, existing gate or Presidencia material changes. No email, filing, social post, authority contact or GitLab write occurs. GitLab reconciliation remains pending restoration.

## Resumen en español

Se conserva únicamente un recibo público de verificación: dos archivos derivados privados, sus huellas SHA-256, un PDF fuente de 22 páginas y 84 anotaciones. Se han comprobado la coincidencia de la huella del PDF incorporado, los anclajes de los 84 comentarios de Word y los enlaces internos del lector. Esta comprobación estructural no certifica la traducción, la autenticidad de la fuente, la veracidad de las alegaciones ni responsabilidad alguna.

Los documentos completos y el análisis detallado permanecen fuera del repositorio público. Los colores distinguen la necesidad de verificación, las objeciones, las inconsistencias textuales, las conexiones probatorias, las manifestaciones expresas y la corroboración o sus límites. No se modifican el sitio web ni las medidas de control. No se acredita sincronización con GitLab ni conservación privada adicional de estos archivos exactos.
